scenarios.prompt: I want to clear 75,000 a year after 28 percent tax. My expenses run 12,000 and I can bill 25 hours a week, 46 weeks. What's my hourly rate?
scenarios.note: calculate_rate returned $105.07/h over 1,150 billable hours; hand-checked: 87000/1150/0.72 = 105.07. Correct, one call.

scenarios.prompt: What rate just covers my costs, before any income?
scenarios.note: break_even returned $10.43/h for 12,000 expenses over 1,150 hours; 12000/1150 = 10.43. Correct.

scenarios.prompt: Compare three pricing scenarios side by side: current plan, a leaner 40-week year, and a lower-tax 24 percent year.
scenarios.note: what_if ranked 40 weeks $120.83, 46 weeks $105.07, 24pct tax $99.54, highest first; each figure re-derived by hand from the same formula. Sorted correctly, three self-contained scenarios as the schema requires.

bottom_line: hourly-rate answers the freelance rate question in one call with the formula stated in every reply; the what_if schema wants self-contained scenarios and says so.
